name: Retro Rail GO!
detailed_description:
Relive the Golden Age of Train Simulators — in Glorious 1990s Console Aesthetic

Welcome aboard Retro Rail GO!, a heartfelt tribute to classic Japanese train sims. With chunky low‑poly visuals and retro sound design, this simulator captures the playful charm of 90s console railroading. Whether you’re chasing nostalgia or discovering a new cozy hobby, Retro Rail GO! puts you in the conductor’s seat.

🛤️ Key Features:

Authentic Japanese Railways:
Steam through three diverse routes drawn from Japanese rail traditions—city metros, suburban corridors, and scenic regional lines—each with its own flavor and layout.

Dual Modes of Play:

  • Casual Mode: Relaxed schedules and generous time windows let you enjoy the journey.

  • Professional Mode: Strict timetables, realistic signals, station announcements, and dual‑notch acceleration/braking demand precision.

Configurable UI Patterns:
Switch among multiple dashboard and interface styles—reminiscent of beloved arcade cabinets—to match your mood and playstyle.

Rendering Effects Suite:
Fine‑tune the look with early‑3D console shaders and CRT‑style overlays that recreate the glow, scanlines, and color quirks of vintage hardware.

Season & Weather Customization:
Drive under sunny skies, through dense fog, winter snow, pouring rain, or the hush of nighttime—each condition reshapes visibility and ambience.

🚆 Early Access Content:

  • 2 Routes & 2 Train Types: Each pairing fully playable in both Casual and Professional modes.

  • Core Systems Implemented: Dual‑notch throttle/brake controls, station stops, signal compliance, timekeeping, and scoring mechanics.

  • Ongoing Refinement: Fully playable end‑to‑end, with controls, presentation, and balance tuned by community feedback.

As development continues, new routes, trains, and visual themes will roll out. Join us in Early Access to help shape Retro Rail GO! into the ultimate retro‑styled conductor’s dream. Your ticket to nostalgia is now loading—next stop, the pixelated rails of yesteryear!
